caption: The drawing depicts a single saddle, shown from the side. The saddle is primarily shades of brown and tan, with detailed tooling and patterns engraved throughout the leather, including floral designs and a symmetrical emblem in the central rear portion that resembles an eagle or bird motif. A light blue or turquoise trim runs along the lower edge of the saddle and outlines certain sections, including the stirrup and the lower border. The stirrup is rectangular and outlined with the same blue tint, while a silver or gray-colored buckle or metal piece is visible at the bottom of the strap. The pommel and cantle at the top have grayish or metallic caps, and a circular leather piece with a rosette pattern is attached near the rear. There is a small white decorative element, possibly stitched, located toward the lower right side of the saddle. The entire composition is rendered on a plain, off-white or cream background with a subtle rectangular border surrounding the drawing.
title: Saddle
